items.title: Cyera Acquires Oasis Security for $1 Billion to Bolster AI Agent Safeguards
items.summary: Cyera has agreed to acquire Oasis Security for $1 billion, signaling a major investment in securing the rapidly growing ecosystem of AI agents.

items.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence Model Released
items.summary: A new 'frontier intelligence' model, Kimi K3, has been released, garnering significant attention for its capabilities.

items.title: Google Redesigns Search Box for First Time in 25 Years, Signaling AI Integration
items.summary: Google has unveiled the first redesign of its search box in 25 years, a move widely interpreted as a foundational change to better integrate AI-powered search experiences.

items.title: Bot-Detection Startup Spur Secures $200 Million Investment from Insight
items.summary: Spur, a startup specializing in bot detection, has raised $200 million from Insight, highlighting increasing concerns and investments in combating automated threats.

items.title: Gemini API Managed Agents Updated with 3.6 Flash, Hooks, and New Features
items.summary: Google has announced significant updates to its Gemini API Managed Agents, introducing Gemini 3.6 Flash, new hooks, and other enhancements for developers.

items.title: Slopsquatting: A New Supply Chain Attack Weaponizing AI Hallucinations
items.summary: A new cybersecurity threat called 'Slopsquatting' has emerged, exploiting AI hallucinations to launch supply chain attacks.

items.title: OpenAI Explores Scientific Computing in the Age of Agentic AI
items.summary: OpenAI has published insights into how agentic AI is transforming scientific computing, suggesting a future where AI agents play a pivotal role in research and discovery.

items.title: Urgent Warning: Audit AI Agents with Write Access to Public Repositories
items.summary: Developers are being urged to immediately audit any AI agents granted write access to public repositories due to potential security vulnerabilities.

items.title: AI Mode in Google Search Offers 5 Ways to Enhance Real-World Experiences
items.summary: Google highlights five practical ways its AI Mode in Search can help users engage more effectively with the real world, from planning to problem-solving.

items.title: A New Role for Relevance: Guiding Corpus Interaction in Agentic Search
items.summary: New research explores how relevance can be redefined to guide AI agents in interacting with information corpora, enhancing agentic search capabilities.

items.title: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance in On-Policy Diffusion Distillation
items.summary: Researchers are re-evaluating classifier-free guidance techniques within on-policy diffusion distillation, aiming to improve the efficiency and quality of diffusion models.

items.title: HiFi-UMI: Learning Deployable Manipulation Policies from High-Fidelity UMI Data Alone
items.summary: New research introduces HiFi-UMI, a method for learning effective robotic manipulation policies solely from high-fidelity unstructured multi-modal interaction (UMI) data.

items.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning in Agentic AI
items.summary: A new paper delves into the underlying 'physics' of multi-turn, long-horizon planning for AI agents, exploring pre-training and post-training via distillation.

items.title: ClinFusion: A Vision-Centric Multimodal LLM System for Holistic Medical Understanding
items.summary: ClinFusion introduces a novel vision-centric multimodal large language model system designed for comprehensive understanding in the medical domain.

items.title: Mage-VL: An Efficient Codec-Native Streaming Multimodal Foundation Model
items.summary: Mage-VL is presented as an efficient, codec-native streaming multimodal foundation model, promising advancements in real-time multimodal processing.
